hero.subtitle: Case Study: AI & Computer Vision
hero.description: A high-performance real-time computer vision system for automated security monitoring and threat detection using deep learning, processing 4K streams with sub-15ms latency.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.p1: Traditional surveillance systems suffer from high latency and significant false alarm rates. In high-security environments, the gap between an incident and its detection can be catastrophic.
challenge.p2: The core challenge was to engineer a pipeline capable of processing multiple 4K video streams simultaneously. This required maintaining a sub-15ms inference time per frame while achieving over 98% precision in diverse lighting conditions, from harsh midday sun to low-light night environments.

AboutPage.description: I am a Senior AI Engineer specializing in large-scale machine learning systems. With nearly a decade of experience, I transition cutting-edge research into production environments, focusing on LLM orchestration, computer vision, and high-throughput data pipelines.

data.title: Data-First Approach
data.desc: Models are only as good as the data they ingest. I prioritize robust ETL pipelines and high-quality synthetic data generation before hyperparameter tuning.

scale.title: Scalable Architecture
scale.desc: Building for millions, not just local notebooks. My focus is on containerized deployments, low-latency inference, and auto-scaling GPU clusters.

ethics.title: Ethical AI
ethics.desc: Bias detection and mitigation are features, not afterthoughts. I design systems that are transparent, interpretable, and socially responsible.

senior.point1: Leading development of proprietary LLM fine-tuning pipelines reducing inference cost by 40%.
senior.point2: Architecting distributed training clusters on AWS/GCP for multi-modal models.

research.point1: Published 4 papers on efficient neural architecture search (NAS) in CVPR/ICML.
research.point2: Mentored a team of 6 research engineers in deploying real-time object detection systems.
